title: 第十九章 战魔族老祖上第二十章 战魔族老祖下
content_zh:
在厚土大陆上，魔族之中的影魔一脉最擅长各种诡异的攻击手段，与之相遇，往往都是令人族感到十分头痛的。只是这一次影魔族来犯巨象山脉，他们是万万想不到，人族之中竟然还有武书这朵奇葩。
武书在感知到一股强大的魔气正源源不断的从战神殿下方传来时，心中就是十分清楚，经过今次的人魔大战，核心区域的法阵被破坏的程度远超很多人想象的。这个时候，要是没有人能够站出来，就算石碑能够镇住巨象，魔族老祖怕也是镇压不住了。
而现在人魔两族的强者，完全将心思放在了碑灵身上，武书便是寻思着该如何出手？
现在的武书，在没有足够的灵石用来自保的情况下，还是个渣渣。这一点，武书自己很清楚，精神力再强大，那也要看现在身处在什么地方，厚土大陆上的人可都是炼体怪物，只要武书被近身，一个搞不好就将会归西，更何况现在的武书攻击手段除了阵法类的，在精神力攻击方面手段也不多，而每次能够动用的精神力也是有限的。
“老大，快点出手？”
而为了出手便能对众魔族强者有震慑作用，武书觉着再出手前，他还需要戏精附体。
经过短暂的思考，武书内心也是有了腹稿，武书懒散的应声道，“知道了，知道了，别催我。不就是一个魔族老怪吗？有什么好大惊小怪的。想要灭掉他，不就是个放屁的功夫？”
这武书的本意是想通过散漫的态度表现告诉人魔两族，就算是面对魔族老祖这样的老怪物，他也是没有任何压力的。至于为什么感觉不到压力，谁给他的勇气，这就靠其他人去猜了。
武书也是想让众人知道他是有靠山的，武书又是道，“夕日，家师外出历练时，留了些灵石给我防身用，今日为了能够拯救天下众生，我也就忍痛割爱了。”
碑灵会一直请求武书出手帮忙，魔族强者皆是欲出手阻拦的，而在听到武书只是拿出些灵石出来协助碑灵，魔族强者们无不是想要笑出声，傻不拉几的人族小子，魔族老祖是何等人物，区区几块灵石要是能够对老祖造成伤害，我魔族老祖岂不是纸糊的。
不说魔族一干人等懒得出手阻拦了，人族强者一听到武书的话，无不是心中叹息连连。这到底是从哪里冒出来的傻小子，灵石要是能够对魔族老祖造成伤害，今次与魔族强者的对决还打什么打，直接搬些灵石来战神殿，任由魔族强者如何折腾，只要魔族老祖敢出来，冲着他丢灵石不就行了。
武书也是不想张扬，就算出现在他手中的十数块灵石上面皆是刻有圣纹，武书也不想让众人感受到灵石上的神圣气息，圣纹完全处在沉寂状态。
“小灵，我这就助你。”
然后武书就是将十数块灵石丢向碑灵所在位置，就在灵石即将落地的时候，魔族中一名强者是突然动了。这名魔族强者身法十分了得，在接住一块灵石后，便是又回到了魔族强者队伍中。
反复看了看手中的灵石，并未从灵石表面看出任何端倪，魔族强者发自肺腑的笑道，“真是可笑，普普通通的中品灵石也能用来对付老祖，人族真的是没人了吗？都这个时候了，还让个孩子站出来当笑柄。”
他这话一说完，众魔族强者仰天大笑起来。
有人更是趁机嘲讽道，“弱小的人族，待会老祖归来，你们一定会比吞天巨猿死的还惨。”
“是吗？我看未必。”，所有刻着圣纹的灵石皆是已经到位，听到魔族强者嘲讽，武书处变不惊的声音响起，“圣纹，凝。”
当圣纹被触发时，原本魔气横生的战神殿内，瞬间被神圣的气息填满。而先前将一块灵石抓住把玩的魔族强者，握着灵石的那只手臂，瞬间没了生气。魔族强者们完全傻眼了，眨眼的功夫，那块不起眼的灵石就是将同伴一只手臂净化了吗？
“啊？这该死的灵石？”

在承受了绝大部分灵石的圣纹攻击后，欲挣脱战神殿镇压的魔族老祖，简直是撕破了喉咙般的怒喊出。
失去手臂的魔族强者也是怒目道，“该死的人族小子，你刚刚做了什么？”
武书早就做好了准备，一旦圣纹显现，就算人族强者质问他，他也只会说，“现在才知道我的厉害吗？以前师父不止一次对我说过，只要我听话，像这种保命的灵石，我想要多少就有多少。就问你们现在怕不怕？”
武书这种愣头青的表现是着实让魔族强者不知所措的，武书的师父是何方神圣？竟然能够在灵石上刻下阵纹，而且这种刻有阵纹的灵石，还是想要多少就要多少的那种。
堃国中，难道还有隐姓埋名的绝世强者吗？
这种绝世强者要是真的出手了，在场的魔族强者中，怕也是难有敌手。
一想到这些，众魔族强者心里都是有了打退堂鼓的想法。
承受了圣纹攻击后，魔族老祖也是认识到武书带来的威胁，魔族老祖却是并不畏惧武书，毕竟武书这般年纪，仅拥有炼体三重境实力，势力点看待武书，武书的修行能力与废物没多大区别。
不过，魔族老祖也是很好奇，这般人族废物，不该是出自名师之手。而武书如此年轻，即便武书身上有很多灵石，年轻人，毕竟年轻。
于是，被圣纹挤压到角落的黑色魔气中又是传来魔族老祖的声音，“人族小子，能告诉我你师从何处吗？另外，你身上有一股令人厌恶的血脉气息，你出身于那个家族？”
魔族老祖的疑问，或者说来自魔族老祖的质问，武书并不想回答。要搞清楚，现在武书与魔族老祖是对手，而且还是不死不休的那种，对于要死在自己手里的人，还是魔族的人，没必要浪费口舌。
武书懒散的回道，“不能。”
武书这般简练的回答，是让在场所有强者感到意外的。硬气二字，一下就成了武书的代名词。
content_en:
On the thick earth continent, the shadow demon lineage among the demon clan is the best at all kinds of weird attack methods. When encountering them, it is often a headache for the clan. It's just that this time when the Shadow Demon Clan invaded the Giant Elephant Mountains, they never expected that there would be such a strange thing as a martial arts among the human race.
When Wu Shu sensed a powerful stream of demonic energy coming from below the Temple of War, he knew very well that after this battle between humans and demons, the magic circle in the core area had been destroyed to a far greater extent than many people imagined. At this time, if no one can stand up, even if the stone tablet can suppress the giant elephant, the demon ancestor may not be able to suppress it.
But now the strong men of the human and demon tribes have completely focused on the tablet spirit, and Wu Shu is thinking about how to take action?
The current martial arts is still a scumbag without enough spiritual stones for self-protection. Wu Shu himself knows this very well. No matter how strong his mental power is, it depends on where he is now. People on the thick soil continent are all body-refining monsters. As long as Wu Shu is close to him, one of them will return to the west. What's more, apart from formations, the current Wu Shu attack methods don't have many mental power attacks, and the mental power that can be used each time is also limited.
"Boss, take action quickly?"
In order to have a deterrent effect on the powerful demons, Wu Shu felt that he needed to be possessed by a drama spirit before taking action.
After a short period of thinking, Wu Shu also had an idea in his heart. Wu Shu responded lazily, "I know, I know, don't rush me. Isn't he just an old monster from the demon clan? What's the fuss about? If you want to destroy him, isn't it just a fart?"
The original intention of this martial arts book is to tell the human and demon tribes through a casual attitude that even when facing an old monster like the ancestor of the demon tribe, he is not under any pressure. As for why he didn't feel the pressure and who gave him the courage, it's up to others to guess.
Wu Shu also wanted everyone to know that he had a backer, and Wu Shu said, "On the evening of the evening, when my master went out for training, he left some spiritual stones for me to use for self-defense. Today, in order to save all sentient beings in the world, I reluctantly gave up."
The stele spirit will keep asking Wu Shu for help, and the strong demons want to stop it. But when they heard that Wu Shu just took out some spirit stones to help the stele spirit, the strong demons all wanted to laugh out loud. What a foolish human boy, what kind of person is the ancestor of the demon clan? If a few spirit stones can cause harm to the ancestor, wouldn't my ancestor of the demon clan be a piece of paper?
Not to mention that the demon clan was too lazy to stop him, the strong human clan members all sighed in their hearts when they heard Wu Shu's words. Where did this stupid boy come from? If the spirit stone can cause harm to the demon ancestor, there is no need to fight against the demon strong man this time. Just bring some spiritual stones to the war temple and let the demon strong man do whatever he wants. As long as the demon ancestor dares to come out, just throw the spirit stone at him.
Wu Shu also didn't want to make it public. Even if the dozens of spiritual stones that appeared in his hand were all engraved with sacred patterns, Wu Shu didn't want everyone to feel the sacred aura on the spiritual stones. The sacred patterns were completely silent.
"Xiao Ling, I will help you right now."
Then Wu Shu threw a dozen spirit stones towards the location of the tablet spirit. Just when the spirit stones were about to fall to the ground, a strong man from the demon clan suddenly moved. This demon strongman has very good physical skills. After catching a spiritual stone, he returned to the team of demon strongmen.
After repeatedly looking at the spirit stone in his hand, he didn't see any clues from the surface of the spirit stone. The powerful demon clan laughed from the bottom of his heart and said, "It's really ridiculous. Ordinary middle-grade spirit stones can also be used to deal with the ancestors. Is there really no one in the human race? At this time, a child is allowed to stand up and become the butt of the joke."
As soon as he finished speaking, all the powerful demons looked up to the sky and laughed.
Someone even took the opportunity to mock and said, "Weak human race, our ancestors will return later.", you will definitely die worse than the sky-swallowing giant ape. "
"Yeah? I don't think so. "All the spiritual stones engraved with the holy patterns are in place. Hearing the taunts of the powerful demon clan, the Martial Arts Department's calm voice sounded, "The holy patterns are condensed. "
When the holy pattern was triggered, the War Temple, which was originally full of demonic aura, was instantly filled with sacred aura. The strong demon clan man who had previously grabbed and played with a spiritual stone suddenly lost his life in the arm holding the spiritual stone. The powerful demons were completely dumbfounded. In the blink of an eye, did that inconspicuous spiritual stone purify one of their companions' arms?
"Huh? This damn spirit stone? "
After withstanding the attacks of most of the sacred marks from the spirit stones, the demon ancestor who wanted to break free from the suppression of the War Temple simply shouted angrily as if his throat was being torn.
The powerful demon who lost his arm also glared angrily, "Damn human boy, what did you just do? "
Wu Shu has been prepared for a long time. Once the holy mark appears, even if a strong human race questions him, he will only say, "Do you know how powerful I am now? Master has told me more than once before that as long as I am obedient, I can have as many life-saving spiritual stones as I want. I just want to ask you if you are afraid now? "
Wu Shu's stupid performance really makes the powerful demon clan bewildered. Who is Wu Shu's master? It is actually possible to carve formation patterns on the spirit stone, and the spirit stone with the formation patterns engraved on it can be used as much as you want.
Are there any peerless strong men who remain anonymous in the Kun Kingdom?
If such a peerless strong man really takes action, there will probably be no opponent among the strong demons present.
Thinking of this, all the strong demon clan members had the idea of retreating.
After withstanding the attack of the holy mark, the ancestor of the demon clan also realized the threat posed by Wu Shu, but the ancestor of the demon clan was not afraid of Wu Shu. After all, at Wu Shu's age, he only had the strength of the third level of body refining. The power points regarded Wu Shu, and Wu Shu's cultivation ability was not much different from that of trash.
However, the ancestor of the demon clan was also very curious. Such human waste should not have come from the hands of a famous master. And Wu Shu is so young, even if Wu Shu has a lot of spiritual stones, young people are still young after all.
Then, from the black demonic energy squeezed into the corner by the holy pattern, the voice of the demon ancestor came again, "Human boy, can you tell me where you studied? In addition, you have a disgusting aura of blood. Which family are you from? "
Wu Shu didn't want to answer the question from the Demon Clan Ancestor, or rather the question from the Demon Clan Ancestor. It must be understood that Wu Shu and the ancestor of the Demon Clan are rivals now, and they are still determined to fight to the death. There is no need to waste words on the people who are going to die in their hands, who are still Demon Clan.
Wu Shu replied lazily, “No. "
Wu Shu's concise answer surprised all the powerful people present. The word toughness suddenly became synonymous with martial arts.
